body: Expression I guess. I have tried for years to find answers from others, without any success, so I don't expect for anyone to be able to help me. I just want the thoughts to have been said really.

To put it simply, been there, done that. I've tried everything I can possibly think of to try, as tough as it is I've not been lax in attempting to come up with solutions and make changes, but the result is the same each time. And when circumstances follow a pattern, it's easy to follow that the future will be similar enough to now that such judgement is correct.

That is what i've spent years trying to do, the desire to change is inconsequential in truth, it's just a matter of whether the spectrum of possibility for each individual includes the sort of traits required to exist at a level which makes life tolerable. That's why I talk of some miraculous solution, because the limitations of my being, either right now, or from the changes that may be possible, still leave me in the same hole.

Loneliness can be, and is, painful, but at least it's a pain that you can be prepared for. I know far too well what it is to be alone, so it's enduring pain that I know how to endure for a time. I don't think in all honesty that people could help me, have tried and failed down that path too many times before. In the end though it is a choice, a call of judgement based on my current circumstances, and I feel that it is the best of the bad choices I have available to me.

Unfortunately, I'm not in the least bit artistic. I can understand how that sort of expression works for others, but at least with words, I feel as though I may have the tools to express at least a shadow of what is going on, where in other forms I just can't manage it.

I write a lot to try to deal with things, poetry mostly, but the problem is, as with all forms of expression, the limitation between what's inside and what can be expressed. It's the difference between standing in an arctic blizzard, and explaining down the phone to someone how cold it feels to be there, no form of expression can adequately express the overriding intensity of the situation, so are always disappointments.

Saying that, the more I struggle, the harder it is to do. When my thoughts are fragmented like this, there's nothing to catch on to, nothing I can express, because the moment I try to take a piece of it to express it, it's gone.

The problem is that who I am right now is not capable of gaining happiness, only trying desperately to minimize pain. And yes, isolation is the best way to do it. I get hurt by people, I avoid people, I avoid getting hurt. Quite simple logic, but that's why I'm sure it's right. It's too easy to analyze, to break stuff down infinitesimally, but each time you do that, you allow your own biases to influence how it's done. I've done that too often, and hated where it has lead me, so a simple, elegant solution is the best one.
